reason: Execution transactions took one global advisory key exclusively, so every project's worker SQL ran one at a time. They now hold that key shared plus an exclusive per-runtime key; the first shared-row write takes a schema-qualified shared-row writer key; StoreTransaction rereads shared rows under it and gains lock_shared_rows (used by the Butler global check and storage ingest); the host Work batch keeps the key exclusive but checks readiness without it. Per-id single-integer advisory keys (operation, run, Butler session, workspace provenance, project name) move off the execution key's value through advisory_keys.per_id_key, and the Work batch also checks owner fence preconditions without the key. Selected: the new PostgreSQL race tests (including a real colliding operation id and the real Butler global-check race) (test_execution_locks: concurrency, same-runtime serialization, ownership-row ordering, shared-row writes, stale rows, opposite-order writes, read-then-write, cross-project writes, Work batch exclusion, ownership change, handoff, raw writes, SQLite no-op), the execution scope and coordination contracts, Work batches (including the new waiting-batch test), deployment handoff lifecycle, handoff admission and participants, the execution worker, store transactions, storage integrations (ingest) and Butler instructions (global check). Selecting test_runtime_coordination provisions the CI PostgreSQL database for the PostgreSQL variants.
exclusions: Tests that fail identically on pristine origin/main are not selected: test_butler_instructions::test_global_check_uses_saved_butler_harness_effort, test_butler_sessions::test_reservation_api_is_project_scoped_and_reuses_active_session, five test_setup tests (event-loop responsiveness, concurrent scratch creation, interrupted migration, setup status contract, image preparation) and test_workspace_provenance::test_large_unchanged_checkout_shares_chunks_and_queries_only_compact_index; the rest of those files, which exercise the per-id advisory key callers, is selected by node id. SQLite variants of the PostgreSQL-only lock tests skip by design. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed. The scratch-Core load A/B, statement captures and the independent subagent reviews are recorded in the PR, not executed by CI.
